title: [Bugs] SMF reports "IP is used" and "UE IP pool exhausted" after gNB CU/DU restart
body: ## Bug Description I am performing an 5G SA E2E connectivity test using one(or multiple) CPE and one gNB. I have observed an intermittent issue whenever I stop and restart the gNB CU/DU. Occasionally, when the SMF attempts to assign IP address 10.60.41.41 to the UE, the program log reports that the IP address is already in use. It appears that the previously allocated UE IP is not being released properly, as if the old IP allocation is still being retained. Whenever this happens, the only workaround is to stop free5GC (using Ctrl+C) and run **run.sh** again. After restarting free5GC, the UE can obtain the IP address successfully and registration completes normally. This issue is intermittent and only occurs after restarting the gNB CU/DU and CPE power off/on. ## To Reproduce Steps to reproduce the behavior: 1. Ensure UE obtained IP address successfully 2. Kill gNB CU/DU 3. Re-run gNB CU/DU 4. Check free5gc log ## Expected Behavior UE successfully obtained IP after gNB CU/DU resumed ## Screenshots - **SCTP shutdown and NGSetup** - **Registration Accept** - **PDU Session Establishment NOT accept** ## Environment **Please, complete the following information:** - free5GC Version: v4.2.3 - OS: 22.04.5 LTS (Jammy Jellyfish) - Kernel version: 6.8.0-124-generic - go version: go1.26.2 linux/amd64 - C compiler version (optional): gcc version 11.4.0 ## Trace Files ### Configuration Files [free5gc-config_202608.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/30697603/free5gc-config_202608.zip) ### PCAP File [after_killcudu_pdu_NOK_202608.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/30697676/after_killcudu_pdu_NOK_202608.zip) ### Log File [program log_202608.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/30697463/program.log_202608.txt) ## System Architecture (Optional) 5G E2E CPE-->gNB-->free5gc(Build and Install free5GC from source code) Test single/multiple UE attach/registration/PDU Test DL/UL throguhput
